evidence.name: @gongfpp/dsh-novel-fish
limitations: Patch references and transitive dependencies are not validated

description.en: Append a passage from a browser-local book below the real reasoning or tool output when you expand selected native chat regions. Imports EPUB/TXT/MD and remembers book progress without writing novel text to the conversation. Declares only DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 and Node >=22; depends on chat DOM. EPUB is text-only and excludes DRM.
description.zh: 主动展开选中的原生聊天区域时，在真实思考或工具输出下追加本地小说，支持 EPUB/TXT/MD 导入和各书进度；小说不写入会话数据。仅声明兼容 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2、Node >=22，依赖聊天 DOM；EPUB 只取文字，不支持 DRM。

security.result: No admission-blocking issue found in reviewed paths

controls.note: Host entry has no behavior. Browser setup registers local settings, local storage and a chat presentation adapter; no model/session-write or network service is called.
EPUB reads referenced XML/spine entries through a shared 128 MiB streaming budget and CRC check, rejects entity declarations, and limits references to archive-local paths.

Advancement requires a trusted disclosure input and verifies the region really opened. Real reasoning/tool output is retained; added book content is React text or textContent. Disposal removes observers/listeners and restores decorated labels.
Book data, passages and progress remain in IndexedDB; changes use transactions and book deletion targets records by book identity.

security.scope: Targeted static review of actual release entries and security-sensitive parsing, file, model/network and DOM paths. Nine generated TypeScript bundles were mapped to 71 public source module paths without rebuilding.

findings.title: Document ZIP entries lack application-level decompression budgets

sources.note: readZipEntries inflates every non-directory entry with inflateRawSync(raw), retains all outputs, and zipMap keeps the resulting buffers. No application entry/aggregate output or compression-ratio budget is set.
table_ingest reads the input, checks AbortSignal before parsing, then enters synchronous ingestToTable. The configured asynchronous tool timeout cannot interrupt synchronous inflate.

findings.precondition: An operator asks the tool to inspect an externally supplied DOCX/XLSX file. The document producer controls ZIP compressed entries; no unauthenticated HTTP endpoint is involved.
findings.flow: External document -> owner-selected local file -> tool readFile -> ingestDocx/ingestToTable -> zipMap -> readZipEntries -> synchronous inflateRawSync and retained buffers.
findings.impact: A small compressed document can expand until the hosting tool process runs out of memory or becomes unresponsive; multiple entries amplify the aggregate. Node platform buffer limits are not a practical application budget.
findings.counterEvidence: The parser rejects encryption, ZIP64 and unsupported compression and checks some archive signatures. XML parsing strips DTDs and does not load external entities; nothing is extracted to disk. These controls do not bound inflated bytes.
findings.remediation: Enforce input size, entry count, actual per-entry and aggregate expanded-byte budgets before retaining output; pass maxOutputLength or use bounded streaming and reject oversized archives. Check cancellation between bounded operations. Publish a fixed parser and re-review the dependent tools against it.

validation.method: Static release/source data-flow review and a bounded Node zlib primitive check. No third-party plugin was loaded or executed.

findings.limitations: This is not a full malicious DOCX execution or a live DSH crash reproduction.

limitations: No plugin installation or activation, model calls, customer-document parsing or host file operations
